lead_independence.headline: National Weather Service explains Port St. Lucie tornado warning timing
lead_independence.lead: The National Weather Service in Melbourne issued a tornado warning Sunday evening after reports of funnel clouds started coming in, but at the point the warning was issued, the tornado had already dissipated. The EF-0 tornado was on the ground for 10 to 15 minutes and later became a waterspout. Because the tornado featured very shallow circulation, it was not picked up well by radar, and reports of the funnel cloud prompted the warning.
